summary: Scope: source contract for issue1032, not an executed full image or invocation authority. The dispatch-only hosted image route uses the existing closed bar-headless controller and exact accepted FSBar recipe, full internal Git histories, fresh empty operation stores and the corrected private pivot-root entry. Its90-minute outer job must retain the unchanged3600-second work plus120-second retirement aperture and20-minute bounded receipt/transport allowance; neither source preparation nor an intermediate toolchain stage renews the clock or closes the full image promise. The workflow seals actual host OpenSSL/loader/library identities, one original monotonic deadline and a reviewed public recipient before image effects. The controller topology/input binds that seal. Only a verified complete candidate may be encrypted with maintained CMS AuthEnvelopedData AES256GCM and RSAOAEP SHA256/MGF1SHA256; streaming uses BER despite the DER CLI option. The private key never enters source, runner or artifacts. Public Actions artifacts retain encrypted candidate bytes and bounded nonsecret metadata; private operator decryption, digest and bounded OCI readback remain separately selected acceptance. Wrong-key/tamper behavior is checked only on authored tiny synthetic bytes. Full build time/output/VFS disk fit, actual image/static-ELF/load/readback, scoped retirement and unavailable provider disposal evidence retain their distinct native obligations. Old failed preflights and Home holds are not retired by this source route. Loaded ABI, Count1, useful play, B2 adoption and publication remain separate.
title: Hosted BAR image source contract and encrypted candidate custody
